Agent 17/35 — rear steering interaction with digital countersteer. Audit 60–140 km/h oversteer catches and rapid reversals to ensure rear steer does not fight the driver, change sign at the wrong time or create excessive yaw as recovery authority opens. Measure actual rear steer angle, yaw and slip. Preserve production-like small rear-steer magnitude and no hidden ESC. Patch logic only with evidence and add mirrored recovery tests.
